_why: The Phase-5 shell gate judges every occurrence of a repeated option, and judges a path from the directory the command runs in or not at all. Each mutant restores one way of judging something the command does not use.

mutations.name: repeat-first-only
mutations._mechanism: Only the first occurrence of an option is returned.

mutations.name: repeat-last-only
mutations._mechanism: Only the last occurrence of an option is returned.

mutations.name: repeat-space-form-unseen
mutations._mechanism: The `--option value` form is not collected.

mutations.name: repeat-equals-form-unseen
mutations._mechanism: The `--option=value` form is not collected.

mutations.name: temp-first-only
mutations._mechanism: The /tmp rule judges one value per option.
mutations.find:
os.path.isabs(value) and _path_within(value, Path("/tmp"))
            for option in TEMP_OUTPUT_OPTIONS for value in _option_values(args, option)
mutations.replace:
os.path.isabs(value) and _path_within(value, Path("/tmp"))
            for option in TEMP_OUTPUT_OPTIONS for value in _option_values(args, option)[:1]

mutations.name: registry-first-only
mutations._mechanism: The registry rule judges one value.

mutations.name: base-is-hook-process
mutations._mechanism: A relative path is resolved from the hook's own directory.

mutations.name: base-is-root-when-outside
mutations._mechanism: A command outside the project is judged as if it ran at the root.
mutations.replace: return (base if root in (base, *base.parents) else root) / path

mutations.name: absent-cwd-is-hook-process
mutations._mechanism: No command directory falls back to the hook's own directory.

mutations.name: empty-cwd-is-unknown
mutations._mechanism: An empty cwd no longer means the root.
mutations.find: if cwd is None or cwd == "":

mutations.name: malformed-workdir-is-root
mutations._mechanism: A workdir that is not a string is read as the project root.
mutations.find:
if not isinstance(cwd, str):  # M:CP-MALFORMED
        return None
mutations.replace:
if not isinstance(cwd, str):  # M:CP-MALFORMED
        return root / path

mutations.name: relative-cwd-admitted
mutations._mechanism: A relative cwd is resolved from the hook's own directory.
mutations.find: if not base.is_absolute() or not base.is_dir():  # M:CP-UNKNOWN

mutations.name: absent-directory-admitted
mutations._mechanism: A command directory that does not exist is trusted.
mutations.find: if not base.is_absolute() or not base.is_dir():  # M:CP-UNKNOWN

mutations.name: temp-relative-admitted
mutations._mechanism: A relative output option is judged from a directory.

mutations.name: state-write-unwired
mutations._mechanism: The state path drops the command directory.

mutations.name: wire-pin-plan-unwired
mutations._mechanism: The impl-plan path drops the command directory.
mutations.find: return _argument_within(args[0], root, root, cwd) and all(

mutations.name: wire-pin-registry-unwired
mutations._mechanism: The registry path drops the command directory.
mutations.find: _argument_within(value, root / ".h-mad", root, cwd) for value in registries

mutations.name: anchor-check-unwired
mutations._mechanism: The spec paths drop the command directory.
mutations.find: all(_argument_within(spec, root, root, cwd) for spec in specs)
mutations.replace: all(_path_within(spec, root) for spec in specs)

mutations.name: script-unwired
mutations._mechanism: The script token is resolved from the hook's own directory.

mutations.name: temp-any-absolute
mutations._mechanism: An absolute output option is not held to /tmp.

mutations.name: default-registry-unjudged
mutations._mechanism: The registry default is not judged.
mutations.find: if not registries and not _argument_within(DEFAULT_WIRE_REGISTRY, root, root, cwd):  # M:WR-DEFAULT

mutations.name: default-registry-always-judged
mutations._mechanism: The default is judged even when --registry replaces it.

mutations.name: default-registry-root-only
mutations._mechanism: A sub-project's own registry is refused.

mutations.name: default-registry-drifts
mutations._mechanism: The policy names another default than the script's.

mutations.name: relative-wrapper-admitted
mutations._mechanism: A relative executable is resolved from the hook's directory.

mutations.name: relative-wrapper-admitted-operator
mutations._mechanism: The same, around an operator-declared command.

mutations.name: interpreter-option-admitted
mutations._mechanism: An interpreter option is judged as the script.

mutations.name: unknown-script-raises
mutations._mechanism: A script with no known directory raises instead of being refused.

mutations.name: equals-word-admitted
mutations._mechanism: A word zsh would expand is judged as a file name.

mutations.name: agy-repeat-first-only
mutations._mechanism: agy: only the first occurrence is judged.

mutations.name: agy-malformed-is-root
mutations._mechanism: agy: a malformed Cwd is read as the root.

if not isinstance(cwd, str):  # M:CP-MALFORMED
        return None
mutations.replace:
if not isinstance(cwd, str):  # M:CP-MALFORMED
        return root / path

mutations.name: agy-absent-admitted
mutations._mechanism: agy: an absent Cwd is trusted.
